analogs.covers: Almost everything: huge leaderless herds, bulls in front, defenders that chase and kill predators, stubborn at water and food

headline: A Cape buffalo herd: bulls in front, three defenders who chase predators down, and stubborn about every bush and puddle.

setting.label: Nomad of forests and hills that claims food and water on the way
setting.note: Nomadic, but temporarily territorial over food and water. Herds happily with Parasaurolophus and Lambeosaurus while still pushing to the front of every bush.

playsLike: You are a large, headstrong herbivore in a huge herd with no overall hierarchy: bulls lead from the front, cows and calves follow. When hunted, up to 3 defenders step out, chase the predator within sight of the herd and may ignore its forfeit, while the rest bunch tightly and back away. In a group you don't flee; alone you flee 3+ Large or any Apex carnivore. You guard food and water from other herbivores, especially ceratopsians.

why.text: Up to 3 defenders chase predators down and may ignore their forfeits. Cape buffalo mob and even kill lions (official inspiration: African buffalo).
Predator reaction Headstrong: grouped Iguanodon do not flee unless success looks unlikely.
No overall hierarchy; bulls lead from the front with cows and calves behind, and the rest of the herd bunches tightly when attacked.
Paces along the water's edge to block other species and pushes in front of bushes. Stubborn and pushy, like the donkeys and bison also named as inspiration.
Large tier, 4,200 combat weight, 800 HP, sprint 1,000 held for 91 s.

notLike: Buffalo defend every herd member; Iguanodon does not defend the other species it herds with.
